nodes.under_the_hood: Static application entry point. It loads styles.css and tailwind.css, includes the Cloudflare Turnstile script for bot protection, then defers api.js, db.js, sync.js, vocab.js, scoring.js, and app.js in that dependency order. api.js is first because it publishes window.SevApi.BASE, which vocab.js reads while building its config. All local asset URLs use the v2.4.0 cache key, and the page registers sw.js after load.

Primary UI and route orchestrator. It hydrates question-bank data from IndexedDB, renders the SPA shell and SAT/PSAT practice flows (including tracking omitted custom test responses, option toggling, and RW passage text highlighting with boundary clamping, as well as the Mistakes Log), and owns onboarding, history, backup, tutorial, and hash/popstate routing. The selected catalog is SAT (2,982 questions), PSAT 10 (2,910 questions), or PSAT 8/9 (2,524 questions); questions are indexed by catalog and only the selected bank plus local imports are resident in memory. Questions use unique catalog UUID primary keys to eliminate collisions across shared College Board item pools, with tri-key resolution (id, externalId, questionId) for past test reviews and mistake analysis. retireEmptiedBanks scans the entire IndexedDB questions store to prevent false-positive deletions of non-active exam banks. Sessions carry the catalog that created them, so the dashboard, history, streak, responses, and Mistakes Log cannot leak another exam's data after a switch. Onboarding provides a unified Google Sign-In flow that connects cloud sync and streams the selected catalog into IndexedDB with an interactive progress bar. Catalog downloads are strictly gated on privacy consent.

Single source of truth for the Cloudflare Worker origin, published as window.SevApi and loaded before every other script. On loopback origins (localhost, 127.0.0.1), resolveBase() automatically defaults to the staging Worker (sevrony-worker-staging.sharthakjaiswal50.workers.dev) for zero-config local testing. Owns the catalog download driver: catalog-scoped metadata, Turnstile-backed tickets, keyset paging, retry with backoff, ticket re-minting when a long download outlives a 10-minute ticket, restart on a mid-download version change, and one resume cursor per catalog in appConfig. The caller injects the `store` callback, because normalizing a question and writing it to IndexedDB needs app.js internals that do not belong here.

IndexedDB wrapper exposed as window.SatPracticeDB. It provides promise-based get, getAll, getAllByIndex, put, putMany, remove, and clear operations for questionBanks, questions, sessions, responses, appConfig, and vocabWords. Database v6 adds a questions.catalog index, with automatic catalog stamping (stampQuestionCatalog) on put/putMany and a healing pass in refreshLocalData so legacy or synced questions are never unindexed. Off-main-thread migration renames the Phase 1 SAT bank/cursor into the sat namespace while stamping local imports as catalog=local. Download cursors live under questionCatalog_<catalog>, so one interrupted exam download cannot resume another.
Dedicated Web Worker for running background IndexedDB data migrations and legacy encryption conversions without blocking the main UI thread.

Pure deterministic scoring engine providing Student-Produced Response (SPR) sanitization, math expression/fraction normalization, and MCQ/SPR answer grading shared across the main thread and background workers.

Vocabulary SRS module. It seeds vocabWords from dsat_vocabulary.json, manages learn and flashcard sessions, and persists resumable session state in localStorage under sat_vocab_state. It exposes isSessionActive(), reloadState(), and rendering/session methods through window.Vocab. Progress updates are written to IndexedDB and optionally synced through SevSync. Includes dynamic Cloudflare Turnstile integration with safe unmounting and offscreen positioning to avoid display-none throttling while securing AI sentence validation endpoints.

Optional Google Drive appData sync module exposed as window.SevSync. It stores link metadata and short-lived access tokens in localStorage, merges local and remote records with last-write-wins rules, and syncs both vocabWords and sat_vocab_state. Background syncing runs only with a valid cached token; manual sync renews the Google session when needed.

Dedicated Web Worker for off-thread Google Drive remote data diffing, delta merging, and storage synchronization. Shared-catalog questions are stripped from both sides of the merge: they are re-downloadable from the worker, so keeping them out of the Drive blob is what takes a synced account from roughly 47 MB down to a few hundred KB. Stripping only the local side would make every remote copy look like a missing record and write the whole bank back into IndexedDB under its old bank id, so remote copies are matched by bank id *and* by the local catalog id set -- a blob written before the download carries the same questions under the original import's bank id. A blob that still holds them forces exactly one rewrite even when nothing else changed.

Network-first service worker with cache fallback for GET requests. It precaches the v2.4.0 application asset set in sat-practice-cache-v2.4.0, bypasses the browser HTTP cache during install, activates immediately, and deletes older named caches. Every worker script that importScripts or `new Worker()`s another file pins the same v2.4.0 key, so a version bump has to be applied together across index.html, sw.js (both CACHE_NAME and the precache list), db.js, db-worker.js, sync.js, sync-worker.js, privacy.html and APP_VERSION in app.js -- a file that asks for an older key is not in the new cache and fails offline. One bump per release, not per commit.
Hand-authored responsive application styles, including the sidebar, modals, loading states, SAT practice UI, and vocabulary session/flashcard layouts.
Committed, precompiled Tailwind utility stylesheet used alongside styles.css.
Static vocabulary seed data fetched by vocab.js when the vocabWords store is empty.

Cloudflare Worker HTTP entry point. Routing happens before method dispatch, so the GET banner is a fallback rather than a short-circuit that would shadow every catalog route. Owns the per-route rate-limit map, the X-Admin-Key check scoped to /api/admin/*, and the deliberate rule that a valid admin key also satisfies the download-ticket gate and exempts the caller from rate limits -- which is what lets tools/upload_catalog.py --verify read pages back through the real public route. Page requests get a deliberately generous budget because the ticket, not the page route, is the per-person cost gate: a tight page budget would not stop scraping but would break a computer lab whose 20 simultaneous downloads arrive from one NAT address.

Shared HTTP helpers for the worker: a CORS origin allowlist (GitHub Pages, localhost, plus an optional ALLOWED_ORIGINS var) that emits Vary: Origin and no ACAO header at all for disallowed origins, a JSON response helper, integer parameter clamping, and base64url codecs.

The endpoints that shipped before the catalog: consent acknowledgement, the Discord feedback relay, and Gemini-backed vocabulary sentence validation. Also exports the shared verifyTurnstile() used by the catalog ticket route, which enforces the token's `action` so a token minted for one endpoint cannot be replayed against another. WORKER_API_KEY is scoped to this handler rather than global. The evaluator model comes from the GEMINI_MODEL var and the hardcoded fallback must name the same model: they once disagreed, so a deploy that did not supply the var silently moved production onto a retired model and every sentence check fell back to the client's heuristic path. The feedback relay caps attachments at five and returns 400 for a missing message, so those are the client-visible cases; a missing DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL surfaces as a 500 rather than a silent success.

Read-only question catalog served out of D1 plus the admin ingestion routes. SAT, PSAT 10, and PSAT 8/9 are a closed catalog set. Each route, ticket, metadata record, page query, ETag, and version is scoped to one catalog; unsuffixed routes remain aliases for SAT so installed Phase 1 clients keep working. The questions table is keyed by (catalog, id), and each catalog question carries a unique UUID as its id (eliminating collisions with overlapping College Board externalId values). The admin migrate action rebuilds the Phase 1 D1 schema in place, preserving SAT rows, while reset is reserved for a staging clean slate.

Worker deployment config. Staging is the default environment so a bare `wrangler deploy` cannot reach production, which is deployed explicitly with --env production. Named environments inherit nothing, so vars, the D1 binding and every secret are repeated per environment and `wrangler secret put` without --env sets the secret on staging only. Staging and production bind separate databases -- sevrony-questions-staging and sevrony-questions -- so a bad upload or a --reset aimed at the wrong target cannot touch the catalog real users download. Lists every secret the operator must set with `wrangler secret put` -- ADMIN_KEY, CATALOG_TICKET_KEY, TURNSTILE_SECRET, GEMINI_API_KEY, DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL -- none of which are ever committed or exposed to the frontend, and ADMIN_KEY deliberately differs between environments so a staging leak grants no write access to the live catalog. GEMINI_MODEL is a var rather than a secret and has to match the fallback in worker/vocab.js.

Cloudflare D1 database holding the shared read-only SAT (2,982), PSAT 10 (2,910), and PSAT 8/9 (2,524) banks (8,416 rows total). `questions` is keyed by (catalog, id), has a contiguous per-catalog seq column for keyset pagination, and stores question JSON in payload; catalog_meta is keyed by (catalog, key) and carries each exam's version and counts. The shared database is well inside the free tier's 500 MB per-database limit and preserves headroom for Phase 2 user-data databases. It exists twice: sevrony-questions for production and sevrony-questions-staging for the required staging-first rollout.
PWA manifest defining the install name, colors, display mode, start URL, and logo icons.
Primary application and PWA icon, referenced by the page, manifest, and service-worker cache list.

2-Way Feedback Hub and Discussions module. It renders the thread list and conversation panes, handles WebP client-side screenshot compression, manages thread resolution statuses, and polls unread counts for notification badges.

Two-way feedback backend endpoints backed by Cloudflare D1 (FEEDBACK_DB). Verifies Google OAuth bearer tokens via Google userinfo, separates Admin and User roles based on ADMIN_EMAIL, handles thread creation, replies, status toggling, and WebP attachments, and sends Discord alert notifications.
Cloudflare D1 database storing feedback threads, messages, and base64 WebP attachments. Separated from QUESTIONS_DB to isolate practice content from user feedback.

Operator and test tooling, not shipped to the browser. build_catalog_db.py converts .sat-test exports into per-exam SQLite databases with unique question IDs (gitignored, ~23 MB each). upload_catalog.py pushes them to the worker in 25-row batches, taking the admin key from an env var, a file or a prompt but never from argv, where it would land in shell history and ps output; it writes catalog_meta last so an interrupted upload leaves the old version string describing a complete catalog, and --verify walks every page back through the real public route. test_worker.mjs, test_catalog_client.mjs and test_sync_catalog.mjs run the worker, the download driver and the sync filter offline against the real catalogs using node:sqlite as a D1 shim, with Turnstile, Discord and Gemini replaced by a recording fetch stub so the feedback relay and the evaluator's model choice are asserted without network.
